android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.why_apps_ask: Provides exact GPS coordinates for live navigation, location tagging, or nearby service lookup.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.if_denied: Maps still load using approximate city-level estimates, but turn-by-turn guidance will lag.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.risk_if_allowed: App can build a precise log of your physical movements and routines in the background.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.how_to_limit: Set location access to 'Only while using the app' in Android settings.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.why_apps_ask: Determines your general area (city or neighborhood) using cell towers and Wi-Fi.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.if_denied: You must manually type in your location or zip code for local weather or search results.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.risk_if_allowed: Reveals your general neighborhood and city to ad networks without high battery drain.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.how_to_limit: Allow coarse location instead of precise location for non-navigation apps.

android.permission.CAMERA.why_apps_ask: Captures photos, videos, profile pictures, or scans QR codes directly inside the app.
android.permission.CAMERA.if_denied: In-app photo capture won't work; you will need to upload existing images from your gallery.
android.permission.CAMERA.risk_if_allowed: Invasive apps could take background photos or record video while open.
android.permission.CAMERA.how_to_limit: Grant permission on a 'Ask every time' basis.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.why_apps_ask: Finds friends using the service or lets you invite contacts directly.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.if_denied: You must manually search for users by their username or phone number.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.risk_if_allowed: App can upload your entire address book (names, numbers, emails) to remote servers.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.how_to_limit: Deny this permission unless using a primary messaging app.

android.permission.READ_SMS.why_apps_ask: Auto-reads 2FA verification codes sent via text message.
android.permission.READ_SMS.if_denied: You will need to manually copy and paste OTP codes from your SMS inbox.
android.permission.READ_SMS.risk_if_allowed: High privacy risk: App can read private text messages, bank alerts, and sensitive codes.
android.permission.READ_SMS.how_to_limit: Deny this permission and manually type OTP verification codes.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.why_apps_ask: Enables voice notes, audio calls, voice search, or video recording.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.if_denied: Microphone features will be disabled; voice calling or recording will not function.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.risk_if_allowed: Background audio capture or keyword listening potential.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.how_to_limit: Set permission scope to 'Only while using the app'.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.why_apps_ask: Accesses photos, media, or documents saved on your device storage.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.if_denied: App cannot read or import local files directly from storage.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.risk_if_allowed: Broad access to photos, downloads, and stored documents.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.how_to_limit: Use Android's scoped photo picker instead of granting full storage access.
